message_text: Can someone explain why the tuition page shows $12,500 but my bill says $14,200?
The $12,500 figure is base tuition only. Your bill may include additional fees such as the technology fee ($350), student activity fee ($200), and lab fees.
Why aren't those listed on the main tuition page? That's super misleading.
I apologize for the confusion. The detailed fee breakdown is available on the Bursar's page. I understand this should be more transparent.
Yeah that's pretty deceptive honestly. Parents are making decisions based on that tuition page number.
Your feedback is noted and I'll pass it along to our web team. In the meantime, you can view the complete cost of attendance at the Financial Aid calculator page.
